 Print 'KING' UPDATE_ Shah Rukh Khan teases romantic side with “Qaatil nahi… Aashiq hoon”; fans react . Bollywood's Badshah Shah Rukh Khan has unveiled a striking new poster of his upcoming film 'KING'. The new poster offers a glimpse of SRK's character, blending romantic charm with an intense action-oriented presence. The actor is seen holding a rose between his lips, while his fierce expression adds a darker edge to the look. Directed by Siddharth Anand , the film is scheduled to release in cinemas worldwide on December 24, 2026. The poster was shared with the caption, "Aaj phir yaad aaya... Qaatil nahi… Aashiq hoon… #KING In cinemas 24.12.26." Shah Rukh Khan's new look sparks fan reactions 
 Several fans expressed excitement about the actor's appearance and the film's upcoming release. One fan commented, "The KING... Brand." Another wrote, "Biggest Tsunami is Loading." A third admirer described the superstar as "The One & Only King of Bollywood!" Another comment focused on the film's father-daughter pairing, stating, "Now king is coming with his daughter Suhana khan ." 'KING' prepares for a December release 
 'KING' is scheduled to arrive in theatres on December 24, placing it in the middle of an interesting Christmas release period. The date also brings the film into competition with several major projects expected around the same time. The upcoming releases include 'Avengers: Doomsday' and 'Dune: Part Three'. Nagarjuna's 'King100', announced on his 67th birthday along with its release date, is also part of the holiday-season lineup. Suhana Khan and leading actors feature in the cast 
 Shah Rukh Khan headlines 'KING', which features an ensemble cast comprising Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Rani Mukerji, Abhishek Bachchan, Arshad Warsi and Anil Kapoor. Shah Rukh Khan's last major theatrical releases include 'Pathaan', 'Jawan' and 'Dunki', all of which arrived in 2023. The three films turned out to be blockbusters and with 'King', SRK is expected to continue his success streak.
